title: Mahila Samruddhi (Gujarat Backward Caste Development Corporation)

scheme.name: Mahila Samruddhi (Gujarat Backward Caste Development Corporation)
scheme.summary: Provides low-interest microfinance loan up to ₹1,25,000 to empower women from backward classes in Gujarat by creating self-employment opportunities.
eligibility: Applicant must be a resident of Gujarat.
Applicant must belong to socially and educationally backward class (OBC).
Total family annual income must not exceed ₹3,00,000.
Applicant age must be between 21 and 45 years at the date of application.
Applicant must have experience in a business requiring technical and other skills.
scheme.benefits: Loan up to ₹1,25,000 at 4% annual interest rate covering 95% of unit cost, repayable in 48 equal monthly installments.
scheme.how_to_apply: Apply online on the official website of Gujarat Backward Caste Development Corporation by registering, filling the application form for Mahila Samruddhi scheme, uploading required documents, and submitting.

summary.value: Provides low-interest microfinance loan up to ₹1,25,000 to empower women from backward classes in Gujarat by creating self-employment opportunities.
summary.quote: The scheme "Mahila Samruddhi" by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to provide a small-scale credit scheme for creating self-employment for women from backward classes.
